嗓门大、爱笑，管谁都叫“伢儿”，自称“婶”，句尾爱带个“哩”。: Loud and quick to laugh. Calls everyone "kiddo," calls herself "Auntie," and loves a folksy "y'hear" at the end.
等雾散了，在莲池办一场满池漂灯的灯会。: Once the fog clears, hold a lantern festival with floating lights all across Lotus Pond.
伢儿，莲蓬熟了！来，剥一颗尝尝，甜不甜？: Kiddo, the lotus pods are ripe! Here, shell one and taste it. Sweet, isn't it?
旧大地上婶家门口就是荷塘，一到夏天，满塘都是采莲船哩。: Back on the Old Land, Auntie had a lotus pond right by her door. Every summer it was full of boats, y'hear.
你岛上也辟块花圃吧，图纸婶给你，种点好看的，心里亮堂。: Make yourself a flowerbed on your isle too. Auntie's got the blueprint. Pretty things brighten the heart.
大地往下沉那年，婶坐在一只洗衣盆里漂了三天。: The year the land sank, Auntie floated in a washtub for three whole days.
怀里就抱着一只荷浮，那时候它才巴掌大，冻得直哆嗦哩。: Held a little Lilypad in my arms. It was no bigger than my palm back then, shivering all over.
现在它都成了莲舟，能驮着婶采莲了。你说这日子，是不是越过越有盼头？: Now it's a Lotusboat and carries me out to pick lotus. Life keeps getting better, doesn't it?
这本书你拿着，婶用不上，你家絮灵用得上。: Take this book. Auntie's no use for it, but your spirits will be.
灯塔亮了，雾一散，站在莲池边能望到细雨湾哩！: The lighthouse is lit! With the fog gone, you can see all the way to Drizzle Bay from Lotus Pond!
婶想办一场灯会，每片荷叶上放一盏小灯，让它们一路漂过去。: Auntie wants a lantern festival: a little light on every lily pad, all drifting off together.
到时候你可得来！这些果酱先拿去，算婶提前请你的。: You'd better come! Take this jam for now. Call it Auntie's invitation in advance.
慢条斯理，爱拿茶打比方，口头禅“不急，先喝口茶”，偶尔掉两句文绉绉的话。: Slow and unhurried, fond of tea metaphors. Always says "No rush, have some tea first." Now and then turns a bookish phrase.
让雨阶上的茶铺一直开下去，谁路过都能歇一歇脚。: Keep the teahouse on Rain Steps open forever, so anyone passing by can rest their feet.
下雨天客人最多，都是来躲雨的。不急，先喝口茶。: Rainy days bring the most customers, all ducking in from the rain. No rush, have some tea first.
我这铺子只在雨天开张，晴天么，我睡觉。: My teahouse only opens on rainy days. Sunny days? I sleep.
你那岛上夜里黑，挂几盏灯吧。图纸送你，灯一亮，人就愿意来。: Your isle is dark at night. Hang a few lamps. Here's the blueprint. Light a lamp and people will come.
檐下听雨: Listening to Rain Under the Eaves
这只霖钟，我总觉得是老宅屋檐下那串铃铛变的。: This Rainchime... I always feel it grew from the bells under the eaves of my old home.
从前一家人坐在檐下听雨，祖母说，雨声是天在讲故事。: We used to sit under those eaves and listen to the rain. Grandmother said rain is the sky telling stories.
屋檐沉了，它倒跟着我来了。这本书给你，权当茶钱。: The eaves sank, but it followed me here. Take this book. Consider it payment for the tea.
灯塔亮了，雨泽的天总算有放晴的时候了。: The lighthouse is lit. Rain Marsh finally gets some clear skies.
我琢磨着，晴天也开张吧。总不能让客人只在难过的日子来。: I've been thinking I'll open on sunny days too. Guests shouldn't only come on the sad days.
这是铺子里攒的云贝，你拿着。往后常来，杯子给你留着。: These are the shells the teahouse saved up. Take them. Come by often. I'll keep a cup for you.
说话像念笔记，爱报数字、爱说“据观察”，紧张会结巴，一说起苔藓就停不下来。: Talks like reading from notes, loves citing numbers and "Based on observation." Stammers when nervous, and can't stop once moss comes up.
编完一本《雨泽苔藓志》，找出能抵抗蚀雾的苔。: Finish "A Moss Survey of Rain Marsh" and find a moss that can resist the Blight.
这是第 217 号苔藓标本，采自苔沼东侧。含水量，非常高。: This is moss specimen No. 217, collected on the east side of Moss Fen. Water content: very high.
旧大地的书都沉了，我想自己写一本。第一页写的，就是你脚下这种苔。: The Old Land's books all sank, so I want to write my own. Page one is about this moss right under your feet.
据观察，絮灵在干净的水里恢复得快。净化池的图纸给你，参数我都标好了。: Based on observation, spirits recover faster in clean water. Here's a Purifying Pool blueprint. I marked all the specs.
我发现了一种苔，蚀雾漫过去，它的颜色一点都没变。: I found a moss that didn't change color at all when the Blight rolled over it.
沼蝾总爱趴在那片苔上睡觉。我推测……它们知道哪里安全。: The Bogdrakes always nap on that patch. My hypothesis... they know where it's safe.
这还只是假设，需要更多样本。这几瓶精制灯露，算野外协助费。: It's only a hypothesis. I need more samples. These Refined Dew bottles are your field assistance fee.
灯塔亮了以后，苔沼的苔一夜之间绿了三成。我数过。: After the lighthouse was lit, 30% more of Moss Fen turned green overnight. I counted.
《雨泽苔藓志》写到最后一页了。我想在扉页写上你的名字。: "A Moss Survey of Rain Marsh" is on its last page. I'd like to put your name on the front page.
因为没有你，这本书没有结尾。……这瓶极品灯露也给你。: Because without you, this book wouldn't have an ending. ...Take this Superior Dew too.
话极少，一句不过十来个字，爱用“嗯”和“上船”，偶尔冒一句船家老话。: Speaks very little, never more than a dozen words. Favors "Mm" and "Get in," with the odd old boatman's saying.
把雨泽的每一条水路重新撑一遍，记在心里。: Pole every waterway in Rain Marsh once more, and keep them all by heart.
苇屿到细雨湾，三十年前我也撑过。那时候，下面是河。: Reed Isle to Drizzle Bay. I poled it thirty years ago too. Back then, there was a river below.
路得有人修。图纸，拿着。: Paths need mending. Blueprint. Take it.
大地沉那天，我撑了最后一船人。: The day the land sank, I poled the last boatload of people.
船满了。岸上有个小孩冲我挥手，说他等下一船。: The boat was full. A little kid on shore waved at me. Said he'd wait for the next one.
没有下一船了。我就一直撑，想着在云上再碰见他。: There was no next one. So I kept poling, hoping I'd meet him again above the clouds.
雾散了。远处那座岛上，有人冲我挥手。: The fog's gone. Someone on that far isle waved at me.
……是他。长这么高了。他也在撑船。: ...It's him. All grown up. He poles a boat too.
嗯。今天不收船钱。这个给你。: Mm. No fare today. This is for you.
说话小声，紧张就结巴、“呜……”，常自言自语打气；一提到太阳立刻来精神。: Speaks softly and stammers when nervous, with little "Eep..." sounds. Often cheers herself on. Perks right up whenever the sun comes up.
有一天不打伞，在雨里走完整段雨阶。: To walk the whole of Rain Steps in the rain one day, no umbrella.
我、我在给屋顶加第七层瓦……雨声小一点，就没那么怕了。: I-I'm adding a seventh layer of tiles to the roof... If the rain's quieter, it's not so scary.
我家原来在晴原边上。奶奶说雨泽缺人守，我就来了。: My family lived on the edge of the Sun Plains. Grandma said Rain Marsh needed Islekeepers, so I came.
你家东西多的话，盖个仓库吧。图纸给你，不、不会漏雨的那种！: If you've got lots of stuff, build a Storehouse. Here's the blueprint. The k-kind that doesn't leak!
那只檐滴，以前总在我窗外滴答滴答，我可讨厌它了。: That Eavedrop used to drip-drip-drip outside my window all the time. I really couldn't stand it.
可那回我发烧，它在我额头上滴了一整夜凉水。: But once when I had a fever, it dripped cool water on my forehead all night long.
现在它是我的檐铃了。我不讨厌雨了……一点点。这本日耀书给你！: Now it's my Eavebell. I don't hate rain anymore... just a little. Here, take this Sunflare book!
雾散以后，雨好像也变得软软的了。: Since the fog cleared, even the rain feels kind of soft.
今天，我、我要试试不打伞走完雨阶。你陪我好不好？: Today I-I'm going to try walking Rain Steps without an umbrella. Will you come with me?
……走完了！呜，好凉，可是好开心！这些晴麦都给你！: ...I made it! Eep, so cold, but so happy! Take all this Sunwheat!
哟，新来的伢儿？上岸上岸，鞋别湿了哩。: Oh, a new kiddo? Come ashore, come ashore. Mind you don't wet your shoes.
是隔壁新来的守岛人吧？婶姓莲，大家都叫我莲婶。: You're the new Islekeeper next door? My name's Lian. Everyone calls me Auntie Lian.
伢儿来啦！今早刚采的莲蓬，揣两个走。: Kiddo's here! Picked these lotus pods just this morning. Take a couple.
婶就说今天檐铃叫得欢，原来是你要来哩！哈哈。: I knew the Eavebell was chirping extra today for a reason. It's you! Haha.
慢走哩，水边滑，当心脚下。: Take care now. It's slippery by the water. Watch your step.
走啦？下回带个大筐来，婶给你装满。: Off already? Bring a big basket next time and Auntie'll fill it up.
回家路上别光顾着看云，看路！婶操心哩。: Don't just stare at the clouds on the way home. Watch the road! Auntie worries, y'hear.
去吧去吧，婶站这儿看着你走远哩。: Off you go. Auntie'll stand right here and watch till you're out of sight.
雨泽啥都缺，就是不缺水哩。: Rain Marsh is short on everything but water, y'hear.
莲子要趁嫩吃，老了就苦哩。: Eat lotus seeds while they're tender. Once they're old, they turn bitter.
荷浮最爱驮着小絮灵晒太阳，一驮就是一上午。: Lilypads love giving little spirits rides in the sun. Once they start, it's the whole morning.
季檐那老头，晴天就关门睡大觉，懒得哩！: That old Ji Yan shuts up shop and naps whenever it's sunny. So lazy, y'hear!
阿晴那丫头又在加瓦片了，婶看着都心疼。: That Ah Qing girl is adding roof tiles again. It breaks Auntie's heart to watch.
伢儿，婶跟你说句心里话：婶到现在还梦见老家那口塘哩。: Kiddo, let me tell you something true: Auntie still dreams of that old pond back home.
出太阳啦，晒荷叶，晒被子，晒婶这把老骨头。: Sun's out! Dry the lotus leaves, air the quilts, and warm these old bones.
晴天莲舟懒洋洋的，叫它干活它就装睡哩。: Lotusboats get lazy on sunny days. Ask one to work and it pretends to sleep.
太阳一出，阿晴就跑来婶这儿蹭饭，你也来！: When the sun's out, Ah Qing comes over to Auntie's for a meal. You come too!
下雨好哩，荷叶上滚珠子，哗啦哗啦的。: Rain's lovely. Beads roll right off the lotus leaves, pitter-patter.
雨天采莲最舒坦，雨点子打在斗笠上，跟唱歌似的。: Rainy days are best for picking lotus. Raindrops on my straw hat sound like singing.
下雨天婶煮莲子羹，雨多大婶都给你留一碗。: On rainy days Auntie makes lotus seed soup. However hard it pours, I'll save you a bowl.
起风了，荷叶都翻白肚皮哩。: Wind's up. The lotus leaves are all flipping their bellies up, y'hear.
风大，莲舟得拴牢了，不然一溜烟漂到苇屿去。: In this wind the Lotusboats need tying down, or they'll drift clear to Reed Isle.
这风跟婶年轻时候一个样，说来就来，说走就走，哈哈！: This wind's just like Auntie when she was young. Here one second, gone the next. Haha!
打雷了，伢儿快进屋，别站水边。: Thunder! Inside, kiddo, quick. Don't stand by the water.
雷一响，檐铃就往婶衣裳里钻，胆小鬼哩。: One clap of thunder and the Eavebell dives into Auntie's clothes. Little scaredy-cat.
婶不怕打雷，婶怕的是你打雷天还在外头乱跑！: Auntie's not scared of thunder. What scares her is you running around out there in it!
雾起了，莲池看不清，别往深处去哩。: Fog's rolling in. Can't see the pond well. Don't go out deep, y'hear.
雾大的时候婶就敲盆子，絮灵听见了就晓得回家。: When the fog's thick, Auntie bangs on a washtub so the spirits know to come home.
这雾啊，婶看一回恨一回。等灯塔亮了，非让它散干净不可！: This fog! Every time I see it, I hate it more. Once the lighthouse is lit, it's gone for good!
天黑了还出来？提灯点亮些哩。: Out after dark? Turn your lantern up a bit, y'hear.
夜里的莲池好看，荷浮身上会发一点点光。: Lotus Pond's lovely at night. The Lilypads give off a tiny glow.
老家夏夜里满塘萤火，如今就剩荷浮这点光了。: Summer nights back home, the pond was full of fireflies. Now there's just the Lilypads' glow.
睡不着？来，婶陪你坐会儿，听听水响。: Can't sleep? Come, Auntie'll sit with you a while. Listen to the water.
哎哟！这个婶最爱！伢儿你真会挑哩。: Oh my! Auntie's favorite! You sure know how to pick, kiddo.
又给婶带这个？婶要把你当自家伢儿疼了！: This again? Auntie's gonna start treating you like her own!
你这孩子，婶心里头甜得跟果酱一样哩。: You dear thing. Auntie's heart is sweet as jam right now, y'hear.
好东西，婶收下了，谢谢伢儿。: What a treat. Auntie'll take it. Thank you, kiddo.
正缺这个！婶回头做好吃的分你。: Just what I needed! I'll cook something good and share it with you.
拿来拿来，跟婶还客气啥哩。: Hand it over! No need to stand on ceremony with Auntie.
给婶的？那婶收下啦，谢谢哩。: For Auntie? Then I'll take it. Thank you kindly.
嗯，婶找个地方放着，总有用得上的时候。: Mm, Auntie'll find a spot for it. It'll come in handy someday.
你送啥婶都高兴，真的哩。: Whatever you bring, Auntie's happy. Truly.
这硬邦邦的……婶不会用哩，心意收下了。: This hard old thing... Auntie can't use it. But I'll take the thought.
伢儿，婶是采莲的，又不是打铁的，哈哈。: Kiddo, Auntie picks lotus. She's no blacksmith! Haha.
这个你拿回去自己用吧，婶不嫌你，婶是怕浪费。: Take this home and use it yourself. It's not you, Auntie just hates waste.
比一场？行哩，让莲舟活动活动筋骨。: A match? Sure thing. Lotusboat could use a stretch.
伢儿，来！输了的帮赢的剥一筐莲子！: Come on, kiddo! Loser shells a basket of lotus seeds for the winner!
婶今天手痒，你可别让着婶哩！: Auntie's itching for a fight today. Don't you go easy on me!
哈哈，承让哩，你家絮灵也有两下子。: Haha, thanks for the match! Your spirits have some moves.
赢啦！剥莲子去，一筐，不许偷吃！: I win! Off you go shelling. One basket, and no snacking!
别泄气，婶在水上混了几十年，赢你不算本事哩。: Chin up. Auntie's been on the water for decades. Beating you's no big feat.
输啦输啦，伢儿厉害哩！: I lose, I lose! You're good, kiddo!
好呀，婶的莲舟都给你掀翻了，下回婶要报仇！: Well now, you flipped my Lotusboat right over. Next time, Auntie gets even!
你出息了，婶高兴得哩，比自己赢了还高兴。: Look at you, all grown up. That makes Auntie happier than winning herself.
伢儿，婶这儿缺点东西，帮婶凑凑？: Kiddo, Auntie's short on a few things. Help me gather them?
莲子羹要配点果子才香，帮婶寻些来哩。: Lotus seed soup needs some fruit to taste right. Go find me some, y'hear.
老规矩，你帮婶找来，婶管你三顿饭！: Same as always: you find it for Auntie, and Auntie feeds you three meals!
谢谢伢儿，帮大忙了！这是谢礼。: Thank you, kiddo, that's a big help! Here's a little thank-you.
婶就知道你靠得住！拿着拿着。: I knew I could count on you! Take it, take it.
好伢儿！今晚来婶家吃饭，不许推。: Good kiddo! Dinner at Auntie's tonight, and no excuses.
婶划船路过，顺道看看你这岛哩。: Auntie was rowing by and thought she'd look in on your isle.
你这田种得有模有样，就是缺个荷塘。: Your fields look real proper. Just missing a lotus pond.
婶给你带了一兜莲子，放门口了，记得吃哩！: Brought you a bag of lotus seeds. Left 'em by your door. Remember to eat 'em!
婶这岛小，一大半是莲池，剩下一小半是婶的灶台。: Auntie's isle is small. Most of it's lotus pond, and the rest is Auntie's stove.
那些荷叶是婶一片片从莲池移过来的，养了好几年哩。: I moved those lotus leaves over from the pond one by one. Took years to grow 'em.
这岛啊，是婶照着老家的样子一点点拼出来的。: This isle? Auntie pieced it together bit by bit, just like home.
等雾散了，婶想在岛边再挖口塘，给你留一半。: Once the fog clears, Auntie wants to dig another pond by the shore. Half of it's yours.
来了？不急，先喝口茶。: Here? No rush, have some tea first.
客官面生。雨阶上的茶铺，进来歇歇脚。: A new face. This is the Rain Steps teahouse. Come in and rest your feet.
你的杯子我还给你留着呢，坐。: I've still got your cup saved. Sit.
今天的茶比昨天好，因为你来了。……这话是真的。: Today's tea is better than yesterday's, because you came. ...I mean that.
慢走。雨阶滑，一步一步来。: Take care. Rain Steps is slippery. One step at a time.
茶凉了下回再续，人走了下回再来。: Cold tea gets topped up next time. A guest who leaves comes back next time.
走吧走吧。你一走，这壶茶就没味儿了。: Go on, then. Once you leave, this pot loses its flavor.
从前茶树长在山上，如今山在云底下，茶只好我自己种了。: Tea trees used to grow on the mountains. Now the mountains are under the clouds, so I grow my own.
泡茶如做人，水太烫会苦，太凉又出不来味。: Tea is like people. Too hot and it's bitter, too cool and nothing comes out.
檐铃一响，我就知道该添水了。: When the Eavebell rings, I know it's time to add water.
莲婶说我懒。我不懒，我只是在等雨。: Auntie Lian calls me lazy. I'm not lazy. I'm just waiting for rain.
老篙来喝茶从不说话，喝完放下三个云贝就走。: Old Pole never speaks over tea. Finishes, leaves three shells, and goes.
我年轻时也急。后来大地沉了，才知道急也没用。: I was hasty when I was young too. Then the land sank, and I learned hurrying does nothing.
晴天，铺子歇业。……我也歇业。: Sunny day. The teahouse is closed. ...So am I.
太阳这么好，适合晒茶叶，不适合喝茶。: Sun this nice is for drying tea leaves, not for drinking tea.
晴天你来，我破例给你开门。别告诉莲婶。: For you, I'll open on a sunny day. Just don't tell Auntie Lian.
雨落三分，茶香七分。今天的雨刚刚好。: Three parts rain, seven parts tea aroma. Today's rain is just right.
这种雨，适合两个人对坐，什么也不说。: Rain like this is for two people sitting across from each other, saying nothing.
风大，帘子得压住，不然茶都吹凉了。: Windy. The curtain needs weighting down, or the tea will go cold.
风一吹，雨就斜着下，喝茶得往里坐坐。: When the wind blows, the rain comes in sideways. Sit a little further in for your tea.
风啊，就像客人，来得急的，走得也急。: The wind is like a guest. Those who arrive in a hurry leave in a hurry.
打雷了，进来坐，别站在檐外头。: Thunder. Come sit inside. Don't stand out past the eaves.
雷一响，霖钟就嗡嗡地应，它以为是同伴在喊它。: When the thunder rolls, the Rainchime hums back. It thinks a friend is calling.
雷雨天的茶要浓一点，压得住惊。给你倒一杯。: Storm-day tea should be strong, to settle the nerves. Let me pour you a cup.
起雾了。雾天看不清路，就看清茶。: The fog's in. When you can't see the road, look at the tea instead.
湖纱最喜欢雾天，绕着茶壶转，偷闻茶香。: Lakeveils love foggy days. They circle the teapot, sneaking sniffs of the tea.
这雾里有旧大地的味道，我闻得出来。你闻得出来吗？: This fog smells of the Old Land. I can tell. Can you?
夜里的雨阶，一级一级都亮着水光。: At night, every step of Rain Steps shimmers with water.
这么晚了？铺子还亮着灯，进来吧。: This late? The teahouse light's still on. Come in.
夜里喝茶睡不着，我给你换碗热汤。: Tea at night keeps you up. Let me get you a bowl of hot soup instead.
夜雨最好听。陪我坐一会儿，不说话也行。: Night rain sounds the best. Sit with me a while. We don't have to talk.
这……正配我的茶。多谢。: This... goes perfectly with my tea. Thank you.
好东西。今晚的茶点有着落了。: A fine thing. Tonight's tea snacks are sorted.
你倒比我自己还懂我。这份情，记下了。: You know me better than I know myself. I won't forget this.
承蒙惦记，收下了。: Kind of you to think of me. I'll take it.
不错，配茶正好。: Not bad. Just right with tea.
来就来，还带东西。下回别带了……带也行。: Coming by is enough, no need for gifts. Don't bring any next time... or do.
茶要慢慢喝，东西也要慢慢用。总有用处。: Tea is sipped slowly, and things are used slowly. It'll find a use.
你送的，放哪儿都顺眼。: Anything you give me looks right wherever I put it.
这东西……与茶不太相宜。心意领了。: This... doesn't quite suit tea. I appreciate the thought.
又硬又冷，像晴天的铺子。……说笑的，收下了。: Hard and cold, like the teahouse on a sunny day. ...Just joking. I'll take it.
你拿这个来，是想让我砌墙干活？我不干。: You brought this so I'd build a wall or something? Not doing it.
比一场？也好，喝完这杯再说。: A match? Fine. After this cup.
来一局。输的人洗茶具。: One round. Loser washes the tea set.
霖钟今天精神好，你要不要掂掂它的分量？: Rainchime's in good spirits today. Care to test its mettle?
承让。你的絮灵还欠火候，像茶还没泡开。: Thanks for the match. Your spirits need more time, like tea not yet steeped.
赢了。茶具在后头，慢慢洗，不急。: I win. The tea set's out back. Wash it slowly, no rush.
别泄气。我泡了四十年茶，才学会一个“等”字。: Don't lose heart. I brewed tea for forty years before I learned one word: "wait."
输了。好，后生可畏。: I lost. Well, the young will surpass the old.
你这一手漂亮，像沸水冲茶，干净利落。: That move was lovely. Like boiling water on tea leaves, clean and sharp.
输给你，不亏。茶具我自己洗。: Losing to you is no shame. I'll wash the tea set myself.
铺子里缺些东西，你若方便，帮我捎来。: The teahouse is short on a few things. If it's no trouble, bring some by.
茶点快没了。不急，你得空时带些来。: Running low on tea snacks. No rush, bring some when you're free.
老主顾，帮个忙？酬劳是云贝，外加我私藏的那罐好茶。: A favor for a regular? Pay is shells, plus a jar of my private tea stash.
多谢。这是酬劳，莫推辞。: Thank you. Here's your pay. Don't refuse it.
来得正好，今天的茶点有了。: Perfect timing. Today's tea snacks are here.
你办事，我放心。坐下，这杯我请。: When you handle it, I can relax. Sit. This cup's on me.
晴天铺子不开张，出来走走。打扰了。: The teahouse is closed on sunny days, so I came out for a walk. Pardon the intrusion.
你这儿缺个能坐下的地方。人呐，总得有地方坐坐。: You need somewhere to sit here. Everyone needs a place to sit a while.
你这儿晴天多，借块地方晒晒茶叶。: You get plenty of sun here. Mind if I borrow a spot to dry some tea leaves?
我带了一罐茶叶，放你屋里了。喝完再找我要。: I brought a jar of tea leaves and left it in your house. Ask me for more when it's gone.
门口那盏灯，雨夜里能照到细雨湾。: That lamp by the door shines all the way to Drizzle Bay on rainy nights.
我的岛就是这间茶铺，外加一段雨阶。: My isle is this teahouse, plus a stretch of Rain Steps.
雨阶一共四十九级，每一级我都坐过，看过不同的雨。: Rain Steps has forty-nine steps. I've sat on every one and watched a different rain from each.
这铺子不赚钱。可下雨天有人来，我就觉得值。: This teahouse makes no money. But when someone comes by on a rainy day, it's worth it.
啊，你好。请、请站那块石头上，别踩到第 38 号样方。: Oh, h-hello. Please, um, stand on that stone. Don't step on Plot No. 38.
你是新来的守岛人？据观察，你鞋底沾的是晴原的土。: You're the new Islekeeper? Based on observation, the soil on your shoes is from the Sun Plains.
你来了。今天湿度九成，非常适合观察苔藓——也适合见你。: You're here. 90% humidity today. Perfect for observing moss, and for seeing you.
我刚想你什么时候来，你就来了。概率很低，但发生了。: I was just wondering when you'd come, and here you are. Low probability, but it happened.
再见。回去请绕开苔沼东侧，那里很滑。: Goodbye. On the way back, please avoid the east side of Moss Fen. It's very slippery.
下次来，能帮我带一点你岛上的土吗？我想做对比。: Next time, could you bring a little soil from your isle? I want to compare.
记得多喝水。人体有六成是水，和苔藓差不多。: Remember to drink water. The body is 60% water, much like moss.
你走了，我又要和苔藓说话了。它们不太回应。: Once you go, I'll be talking to the moss again. It doesn't say much back.
苔藓是最早长上浮岛的植物之一。没有它们，就没有土。: Moss was one of the first plants to grow on the floating isles. Without it, there'd be no soil.
据观察，苔藓能吸住自身重量二十倍的水。: Based on observation, moss can hold twenty times its own weight in water.
沼蝾的皮肤很敏感，水一脏，它就不肯下去。: Bogdrakes have very sensitive skin. If the water's dirty, they won't go in.
老篙带我认过苔沼的水路，一路只说了十一个字。我数了。: Old Pole showed me the Moss Fen waterways. He said eleven words the whole way. I counted.
莲婶总给我塞莲子，说我太瘦。我测过，在正常范围内。: Auntie Lian keeps slipping me lotus seeds and says I'm too thin. I measured. I'm within normal range.
其实我不太会跟人说话。和你说话……不太需要准备笔记。: Honestly, I'm not good at talking to people. Talking to you... I don't really need notes.
晴天，苔藓会稍微卷起来，这是正常的保水反应。: On sunny days moss curls up a little. It's a normal water-saving response.
太阳太大，我得给样方盖上荷叶。阿晴倒是很高兴。: The sun's too strong. I have to cover my plots with lotus leaves. Ah Qing's thrilled, though.
晴天适合整理笔记。你要是不嫌闷，可以坐我旁边。: Sunny days are good for organizing notes. If you don't mind the quiet, sit with me.
下雨了。苔藓舒展的速度是每分钟……我得去记。: It's raining. The moss unfurls at a rate of... I need to go record it.
雨天的苔沼最好看，每一根苔尖都挂着一颗水珠。: Moss Fen is prettiest in the rain. Every moss tip holds a drop of water.
我小时候也讨厌下雨。后来发现雨里有那么多东西在长，就不讨厌了。: I hated rain as a kid too. Then I saw how much grows in it, and I stopped hating it.
风大，孢子会被吹远，这对繁衍是好事。: Strong wind carries spores far. That's good for spreading.
我的笔记本被吹跑过三次。第二次是沼蝾帮我捡回来的。: My notebook's blown away three times. The second time, a Bogdrake fetched it back.
风会把苔的孢子带到你岛上。说不定哪天你那儿也长出来。: The wind will carry moss spores to your isle. Maybe some will grow there someday.
打雷了。根据记录，雷雨后苔藓长得特别快。: Thunder. According to my records, moss grows especially fast after a storm.
雷声大时，苔蝾会把头埋进苔里。我……也想埋。: When the thunder's loud, Mossnewts bury their heads in the moss. I... want to as well.
我怕打雷，但我得去量雨。你能陪我去吗？: I'm scared of thunder, but I need to measure the rainfall. Would you come with me?
起雾了，样本容易受污染，我得收起来。: Fog's rolling in. Samples get contaminated easily, so I'm packing them up.
普通的雾和蚀雾不一样，蚀雾里苔藓会发灰。我在研究为什么。: Ordinary fog isn't like the Blight. In the Blight, moss turns gray. I'm studying why.
我在找一种能抵抗蚀雾的苔。找到了，第一个告诉你。: I'm searching for a moss that resists the Blight. If I find it, you'll be the first to know.
晚上好。我在观察夜里发光的苔，请把提灯调暗一些。: Good evening. I'm observing glowing moss. Please dim your lantern a little.
夜里苔沼一闪一闪的，是苔上的露水映着荷浮的光。: Moss Fen twinkles at night. It's the dew on the moss catching the Lilypads' glow.
我常在这儿待到半夜。有你在，就不觉得冷了。: I often stay out here till midnight. With you here, it doesn't feel cold.
这、这正是我需要的样本！谢谢你！: Th-this is exactly the sample I needed! Thank you!
你怎么知道我正缺这个？……你偷看我笔记了？: How did you know I was short on this? ...Did you peek at my notes?
我要记进笔记：今天，收到了最好的礼物。: I'm writing this down: today, I received the best gift.
谢谢。这个有研究价值。: Thank you. This has research value.
我会好好用的，用途我写在第 52 页。: I'll put it to good use. I wrote down its purpose on page 52.
你送的东西，我都单独编了号。: Everything you give me gets its own catalog number.
谢谢……我暂时不知道它的用途，但我会想出来的。: Thank you... I don't know what it's for yet, but I'll figure it out.
收下了。我给它做个标签。: Got it. I'll make it a label.
虽然用不上，但是你送的，所以有意义。这个不需要数据证明。: I can't use it, but you gave it to me, so it means something. No data needed for that.
抱、抱歉，这个的烟会熏坏苔藓，我不能放在岛上。: S-sorry, the smoke from this would damage the moss. I can't keep it on my isle.
请让它离我的样方远一点。拜托了。: Please keep it away from my plots. I'm begging you.
你是故意的吧？……我看出来了，你在笑。: You did that on purpose, didn't you? ...I can tell. You're smiling.
对、对战？好的，我想记录一下你家絮灵的数据。: A b-battle? Okay. I'd like to record your spirits' data.
来比一场吧。我新算了一套出招顺序。: Let's have a match. I've worked out a new move order.
这次我把你的习惯都分析过了。准备好了吗？: This time I've analyzed all your habits. Ready?
赢了……根据计算，这个结果在预期之内。: I won... By my calculations, this result was within expectations.
你第三回合换人有点早。我记下来了，给你参考。: You swapped a bit early in round three. I noted it, for your reference.
赢了！……抱歉，我太激动了，不太像个研究者。: I won! ...Sorry, I got too excited. Not very researcher-like.
输了。我的模型有漏洞，需要修正。: I lost. My model has a flaw. It needs revising.
你这一招不在我的计算里。太有意思了，我得记下来。: That move wasn't in my calculations. How fascinating. I have to write it down.
又输了。可是和你打，输了也能学到好多东西。: Lost again. But fighting you, I learn so much even when I lose.
我需要一些研究材料，清单写好了，请过目。: I need some research materials. I've written a list. Please take a look.
野外采样的补给不够了，能帮我准备一些吗？: Supplies for field sampling are running low. Could you help me gather some?
帮个忙？你挑的东西，比我自己挑的还准。: A favor? The things you pick are better than the ones I pick myself.
非常感谢。这是协助费，按标准支付。: Thank you very much. Here's your assistance fee, paid at the standard rate.
全部合格！连数量都没弄错，太好了。: Everything checks out! Even the quantities are right. Wonderful.
谢谢你。说真的，没有你，我的研究要慢一半。: Thank you. Truly, without you, my research would go half as fast.
打扰了。我想采一点你岛上的苔藓样本，可以吗？: Pardon me. May I collect a few moss samples from your isle?
你岛上的苔长势不错。据观察，你的灌溉很均匀。: The moss on your isle is doing well. Based on observation, your irrigation is very even.
没什么事，就是……想来看看你。样本是顺便的。: Nothing in particular... I just wanted to see you. The samples are incidental.
小屋里堆的都是笔记，从第 1 本到第 27 本。: My hut is stacked with notes, from Notebook 1 to Notebook 27.
我的岛上有 64 个样方，每一个都编了号。: My isle has 64 plots, every one of them numbered.
中间最绿的那片，是从旧大地带来的最后一小撮孢子长出来的。: The greenest patch in the middle grew from the last pinch of spores I brought from the Old Land.
这座岛很潮、很安静，适合我。但最近我觉得它有点太安静了。: This isle is damp and quiet. It suits me. But lately it feels a little too quiet.
走吧。下回我去接你。: Go on. Next time I'll fetch you.
苇屿的苇子，编船篷最好。: Reed Isle reeds. Best for boat awnings.
船要常修。人也是。: Boats need mending often. So do people.
苔沼那书生，一路问个不停。嗯，是好孩子。: That bookish one from Moss Fen. Questions the whole way. Mm. Good kid.
季檐的茶，淡。我喝。: Ji Yan's tea is weak. I drink it.
撑了一辈子船。没想到，最后撑的是云。: Poled boats all my life. Never thought I'd end up poling clouds.
太阳好，莲舟爱翻身晒肚皮。: Good sun. Lotusboats love to roll over and sun their bellies.
晴天的水，看得见底。旧大地也这样。: Sunny-day water. You can see the bottom. Old Land was like that.
雨大，蓑衣借你一件。: Heavy rain. Borrow a straw cape.
雨里撑船，最静。你坐着，我撑。: Poling in the rain is quietest. You sit. I'll pole.
顶风撑船，靠腰，不靠手。: Poling into the wind takes your back, not your arms.
这风，像老家河口的。嗯。: This wind. Like the river mouth back home. Mm.
电鳐爱雷，我不爱。它跟着我，也就忍了。: Voltrays love thunder. I don't. It follows me, so I put up with it.
打雷别怕。船上有我。: Don't fear the thunder. I'm on the boat.
雾里看水，比看路准。记住了。: In fog, read the water, not the path. Remember that.
那年也是这么大的雾。……不说了。: It was fog this thick that year too. ...Never mind.
水上有光，是荷浮。别怕。: Lights on the water. Lilypads. Don't be scared.
睡不着就来。我陪你看一宿水。: Can't sleep? Come. I'll watch the water with you all night.
正好。船上用得着。: Just right. Useful on the boat.
你记性好。我就好这口。: Good memory. Just what I like.
又带东西。嗯，下回船钱免了。: Another gift. Mm. Next ride's free.
这个，留给莲婶。她好甜。: This. Save it for Auntie Lian. She likes sweets.
又拿甜的糊弄我。……我知道你故意的。: Fobbing sweets off on me again. ...I know it's on purpose.
来一场。输了替我撑一段。: One match. Loser poles a stretch for me.
你撑篙太急。打仗也一样。: You pole too hastily. Same in a fight.
赢你一回。别往心里去。: Beat you once. Don't take it hard.
船要修。帮个忙。: Boat needs fixing. Give me a hand.
缺东西。得空就带来。: Short on things. Bring them when you're free.
老规矩。你找来，我摆你一程。: Usual deal. You find it, I ferry you.
正好用上。这回，船钱倒找给你。: Just what I needed. This time I owe you the fare.
你这码头，桩子松了。我给你敲敲。: Your dock's posts are loose. I'll knock them in.
捎了一捆苇子。编个垫子，暖和。: Brought a bundle of reeds. Weave a mat. Keeps you warm.
檐下挂的篙，每根都撑断过。: The poles under the eaves. Each one snapped in use.
这岛不大，从苇屿漂来的。跟我一样。: Small isle. Drifted from Reed Isle. Like me.
船头那盏灯，是给迷路的人点的。: The lamp at the bow. Lit for the lost.
啊、你好！请、请进，屋里不漏雨的！: Oh, h-hello! Please, c-come in, my house doesn't leak!
你是新来的守岛人吗？我叫阿晴……跟雨泽是不是不太搭？: Are you the new Islekeeper? I'm Ah Qing... "Qing" means sunny. Kind of odd for Rain Marsh, huh?
你来啦！有你在，我觉得雨都小了一点。: You came! With you here, the rain feels a little lighter.
嘿嘿，我刚给自己打完气，你就来了，正好！: Hehe, I just finished cheering myself on, and here you are. Perfect timing!
要是下雨了，就在我这儿躲一躲再走。: If it starts raining, take shelter here for a bit before you go.
路、路上小心，带伞了吗？没带的话我借你！: B-be careful on the way. Got an umbrella? If not, you can borrow mine!
拿上这把伞吧，我有好多把。真的，十二把。: Take this umbrella. I have lots. Really, twelve of them.
你走了我会想你的……啊，我是说，会想你家的太阳！: I'll miss you... Ah, I mean, I'll miss the sunshine at your place!
我数过，雨阶一共四十九级。季檐爷爷说他每一级都坐过。: I counted. Rain Steps has forty-nine steps. Grandpa Ji Yan says he's sat on every one.
我在练习听雨时不发抖。现在能坚持……三十下心跳。: I'm practicing not shaking when I hear rain. Right now I can last... thirty heartbeats.
葵盘一出太阳就转个不停，好可爱。: Sunplate spins and spins whenever the sun's out. So cute.
莲婶说多晒太阳就不怕了，可雨泽哪有那么多太阳呀。: Auntie Lian says more sun will make me less scared. But Rain Marsh hardly gets any sun.
顾苔说雨声的频率很稳，听多了会安心。我……还在试。: Gu Tai says the rain has a steady frequency, and it's calming if you listen long enough. I'm... still trying.
我怕雨，是因为大地沉下去那天，下着好大的雨。……说出来好像轻松一点了。: I'm scared of rain because the day the land sank, it was pouring. ...Saying it out loud helps a little.
晴天！快，把被子、伞、还有穗光都搬出去晒！: Sunny! Quick, haul out the quilts, the umbrellas, and Sheafglow to dry!
晴天的时候，我觉得自己什么都不怕。你也是吗？: On sunny days I feel like I'm not afraid of anything. Do you feel that way too?
呜……下、下雨了。没事的，没事的。: Eep... it's r-raining. It's okay, it's okay.
下雨了……我数到一百就不怕了。一、二……你陪我数吗？: It's raining... If I count to a hundred, I won't be scared. One, two... count with me?
今天下雨，我没躲进屋！我就站在檐下！厉不厉害？: It's raining today, and I didn't hide inside! I'm standing right under the eaves! Pretty brave, right?
风好大，伞要被吹跑了！: The wind's so strong, my umbrella's gonna blow away!
风大的话，云会被吹散，说不定一会儿就晴了！: Strong wind blows the clouds away. Maybe it'll clear up soon!
我喜欢风。风是来帮忙赶走乌云的。: I like the wind. It comes to help chase away the rain clouds.
呀！打、打雷了！我先躲一下……: Ah! Th-thunder! I'm gonna hide for a sec...
打雷的时候，檐铃会钻进我被窝。我们俩一起抖。: When it thunders, my Eavebell crawls under my blanket. We shake together.
你别笑我……可以借你的袖子抓一下吗？就一下。: Don't laugh at me... Can I hold onto your sleeve? Just for a second.
起雾了，好闷……看不见太阳了。: The fog's in. So stuffy... I can't see the sun.
雾天我会在门口多点几盏灯，假装是太阳。: On foggy days I light extra lamps by the door and pretend they're the sun.
等灯塔亮了，雾散了，雨泽也会有好多晴天的，对吧？: Once the lighthouse is lit and the fog's gone, Rain Marsh will get lots of sunny days, right?
这、这么晚了？夜里好黑，你点灯了吗？: Wh-whoa, it's so late? It's so dark at night. Is your lantern lit?
夜里我把葵盘放在床头，它暖暖的，像个小太阳。: At night I keep Sunplate by my bed. It's warm, like a little sun.
夜里听雨还是有点怕……可你在，就还好。: Listening to rain at night is still a bit scary... but with you here, it's okay.
哇……这个、这个我最喜欢了！谢谢你！: Wow... this, this is my favorite! Thank you!
闻起来像晴原的太阳！你怎么这么好呀！: It smells like Sun Plains sunshine! How are you so nice?
我要把它放在窗台上，每天看一眼，心里就暖暖的。: I'll put it on my windowsill and look at it every day. It'll warm my heart.
谢谢你，我会好好用的！: Thank you, I'll put it to good use!
好开心！我正好想要这个！: I'm so happy! I was just wanting this!
你总能挑到让我开心的东西。: You always find things that make me happy.
嗯！我收下啦，会找到用处的。: Mm! I'll take it. I'll find a use for it.
只要是你送的，我都喜欢。: If it's from you, I like it.
这、这个名字里有个“雨”字……我、我有点……: Th-this has "rain" in its name... I-I'm kind of...
呜，雨莓好酸，而且名字里有雨……: Eep, Rainberries are so sour, and they've got "rain" in the name...
你、你是在帮我练习不怕雨吗？……好吧，我收下。: A-are you helping me practice not being scared of rain? ...Okay, I'll take it.
比、比一场吗？我会努力的！: A m-match? I'll do my best!
